designationHistory.name: Hobe Sound National Wildlife Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Hobe Sound National Wildlife Refuge was established through the generosity of Jupiter Island residents, with an approved boundary of about 400 acres.

authority.citation: Endangered Species Act of 1973 and Refuge Recreation Act of 1962 (as cited by FWS); donated lands

sources.name: FWS ServCat: Compatibility Determination, Fishing, Nathaniel P. Reed Hobe Sound NWR (2006)

review.by: Accepted on the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service's own record (Library decision)
